top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a new organising principle, the time-reversal-protected Z2 invariant, that Kane and Mele predicted and Molenkamp's HgTe experiment then confirmed in nature; about twenty years of independent reproduction make it mature, and the 2016 prize did not cover Z2 physics. The citation must be confined to the 2D quantum spin Hall effect and Z2 topological insulators with the HgTe realisation, because Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang and the 3D pioneers fall outside a three-name limit. P001 is a clean, well-reproduced two-name achievement and my second choice, but it is a refinement of a lineage already honoured in 2005 and 2012. An award is better than no award, so P000 is last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; David Gross, my PhD supervisor, is not a candidate here and I have no apparent connection to any named laureate.
